_**User (2026-09-17 20:20:33Z)**_

what does this project do?

---

_**Agent (claude-sonnet-5 2026-09-17 20:20:37Z)**_

Excalidraw is an open-source, virtual collaborative whiteboard tool for sketching diagrams that have a hand-drawn feel. This repo is its monorepo, containing:

- **`packages/excalidraw/`** — the core React component library (published as `@excalidraw/excalidraw` on npm) that other apps can embed
- **`excalidraw-app/`** — the full web app at excalidraw.com, built on top of the library
- **`packages/common`, `packages/element`, `packages/math`, `packages/utils`** — shared core packages for elements, math/geometry, and utilities
- **`examples/`** — integration examples (Next.js, plain browser script) showing how to embed the library

It lets users draw shapes, diagrams, and freehand sketches, supports real-time collaboration, and is designed to be embeddable in other web apps.

_**Agent (claude-sonnet-5 2026-09-17 20:27:44Z)**_

There are two files involved:

1. **`packages/excalidraw/components/App.tsx`** — around `getContextMenuItems` (line ~12925), this is where you'd edit _what items appear_ in the menu depending on whether you right-clicked the canvas or an element (search for `// element contextMenu` and `// canvas contextMenu`).
2. **`packages/excalidraw/components/ContextMenu.tsx`** — this is where you'd edit the _rendering/styling_ of the menu itself (the popup component).

For adding/removing/reordering menu items (e.g. "Copy", "Delete", "Send to back"), edit `App.tsx`'s `getContextMenuItems`. For changing how the menu looks/behaves visually, edit `ContextMenu.tsx`.

```text
49	      ) {
50	        acc.push(item);
51	      }
52	      return acc;
53	    }, []);
54
55	    return (
56	      <Popover
57	        onCloseRequest={() => {
58	          onClose();
59	        }}
60	        top={top}
61	        left={left}
62	        fitInViewport={true}
63	        offsetLeft={appState.offsetLeft}
64	        offsetTop={appState.offsetTop}
65	        viewportWidth={appState.width}
66	        viewportHeight={appState.height}
67	        className="context-menu-popover"
68	      >
69	        <ul
70	          className="context-menu"
71	          onContextMenu={(event) => event.preventDefault()}
72	        >
73	          {filteredItems.map((item, idx) => {
74	            if (item === CONTEXT_MENU_SEPARATOR) {
75	              if (
76	                !filteredItems[idx - 1] ||
77	                filteredItems[idx - 1] === CONTEXT_MENU_SEPARATOR
78	              ) {

80	              }
```

_**Agent (claude-sonnet-5 2026-09-17 20:49:00Z)**_

Good — `degreesToRadians` already exists in `@excalidraw/math` (`packages/math/src/angle.ts:29`), so you don't need to write your own conversion.

Here's the concrete path to add a "Duplicate rotated" context menu item:

**1. Create a new action**, e.g. `packages/excalidraw/actions/actionDuplicateRotated.tsx`, modeled on `actionDuplicateSelection.tsx` (`packages/excalidraw/actions/actionDuplicateSelection.tsx:34`). Reuse `duplicateElements` from `@excalidraw/element`, then after duplicating, bump each duplicate's `angle`:

```tsx
import { degreesToRadians } from "@excalidraw/math";
// ...inside perform, after getting duplicatedElements:
const ROTATE_BY_DEGREES = 90; // or make configurable

for (const el of duplicatedElements) {
  scene.mutateElement(el, {
    angle: normalizeRadians(
      (el.angle + degreesToRadians(ROTATE_BY_DEGREES)) as Radians,
    ),
  });
}
```

Since rotation happens about an element's own center and `x`/`y` represent the top-left of the unrotated bounding box, you only need to change `angle` — no position math required (that's only needed when rotating multiple elements around a shared centroid, as seen in `resizeElements.ts:404` `rotateMultipleElements`).

**2. Register it** in `packages/excalidraw/actions/index.ts` alongside the other action exports/registrations.

**3. Add a label** to `packages/excalidraw/locales/en.json` under `"labels"`, e.g. `"duplicateRotated": "Duplicate rotated"`.

**4. Add it to the context menu** in `App.tsx`'s `getContextMenuItems` (`packages/excalidraw/components/App.tsx:13021`), right next to `actionDuplicateSelection`:

```ts
actionDuplicateSelection,
actionDuplicateRotated,
```

Note: `PanelComponent` is optional — `ContextMenu.tsx` only needs `name`, `label`, and `perform` to render and execute an item (see `ContextMenu.tsx:84-111`), so you don't need to add a properties-panel button unless you also want one there.

If you want a specific/custom rotation angle rather than a fixed 90°, you'd need a small prompt or a submenu — want me to sketch that too, or should I go ahead and implement the fixed-angle version?

```text
157	    ) {
158	      const action = this.actions[name];
159	      const PanelComponent = action.PanelComponent!;
160	      PanelComponent.displayName = "PanelComponent";
161	      const elements = this.getElementsIncludingDeleted();
162	      const appState = this.getAppState();
163	      const updateData = (formState?: any) => {
164	        trackAction(action, "ui", appState, elements, this.app, formState);
165
166	        this.updater(
167	          action.perform(
168	            this.getElementsIncludingDeleted(),
169	            this.getAppState(),
170	            formState,
171	            this.app,
172	          ),
173	        );
174	      };
175
176	      return (
177	        <PanelComponent
178	          elements={this.getElementsIncludingDeleted()}
179	          appState={this.getAppState()}
180	          updateData={updateData}
181	          appProps={this.app.props}
182	          app={this.app}
183	          data={data}
184	          renderAction={this.renderAction}
185	        />
186	      );
187	    }
188
189	    return null;
190	  };
191
192	  isActionEnabled = (action: Action) => {
193	    const elements = this.getElementsIncludingDeleted();
194	    const appState = this.getAppState();
195
196	    return (
197	      !action.predicate ||
198	      action.predicate(elements, appState, this.app.props, this.app)
199	    );
200	  };
201	}
```

```text
9	} from "./types";

11	export const normalizeRadians = (angle: Radians): Radians =>
12	  angle < 0
13	    ? (((angle % (2 * Math.PI)) + 2 * Math.PI) as Radians)
14	    : ((angle % (2 * Math.PI)) as Radians);
15
16	/**
17	 * Return the polar coordinates for the given cartesian point represented by
18	 * (x, y) for the center point 0,0 where the first number returned is the radius,
19	 * the second is the angle in radians.
20	 */
21	export const cartesian2Polar = <P extends GlobalPoint | LocalPoint>([
22	  x,
23	  y,
24	]: P): PolarCoords => [
25	  Math.hypot(x, y),
26	  normalizeRadians(Math.atan2(y, x) as Radians),
27	];
28
29	export function degreesToRadians(degrees: Degrees): Radians {
30	  return ((degrees * Math.PI) / 180) as Radians;
31	}
32
33	export function radiansToDegrees(degrees: Radians): Degrees {
34	  return ((degrees * 180) / Math.PI) as Degrees;
35	}
36
37	/**
38	 * Determines if the provided angle is a right angle.
39	 *
40	 * @param rads The angle to measure
41	 * @returns TRUE if the provided angle is a right angle
42	 */
43	export function isRightAngleRads(rads: Radians): boolean {
44	  return Math.abs(Math.sin(2 * rads)) < PRECISION;
45	}
46
47	export function radiansBetweenAngles(
48	  a: Radians,
49	  min: Radians,
50	  max: Radians,
51	): boolean {
52	  a = normalizeRadians(a);
53	  min = normalizeRadians(min);
54	  max = normalizeRadians(max);
55
56	  if (min < max) {
57	    return a >= min && a <= max;
58	  }
59
60	  // The range wraps around the 0 angle
61	  return a >= min || a <= max;
62	}
63
64	export function radiansDifference(a: Radians, b: Radians): Radians {
65	  a = normalizeRadians(a);
66	  b = normalizeRadians(b);
67
68	  let diff = a - b;
69
70	  if (diff < -Math.PI) {
71	    diff = (diff + 2 * Math.PI) as Radians;
72	  } else if (diff > Math.PI) {
73	    diff = (diff - 2 * Math.PI) as Radians;
74	  }
75
76	  return Math.abs(diff) as Radians;
77	}
```

```text
22	export type DialogSize = number | "small" | "regular" | "wide" | undefined;
23
24	export interface DialogProps {
25	  children: React.ReactNode;
26	  className?: string;
27	  size?: DialogSize;
28	  onCloseRequest(): void;
29	  title: React.ReactNode | false;
30	  autofocus?: boolean;
31	  closeOnClickOutside?: boolean;
32	}
33
34	function getDialogSize(size: DialogSize): number {
35	  if (size && typeof size === "number") {
36	    return size;
37	  }
38
39	  switch (size) {
40	    case "small":
41	      return 550;
42	    case "wide":
43	      return 1024;
44	    case "regular":
45	    default:
46	      return 800;
47	  }
48	}
49
50	export const Dialog = (props: DialogProps) => {
51	  const [islandNode, setIslandNode] = useCallbackRefState<HTMLDivElement>();
52	  const [lastActiveElement] = useState(document.activeElement);
53	  const { id } = useExcalidrawContainer();
54	  const isFullscreen = useEditorInterface().formFactor === "phone";
55
56	  useEffect(() => {
57	    if (!islandNode) {
58	      return;
59	    }
60
61	    const focusableElements = queryFocusableElements(islandNode);
62
63	    setTimeout(() => {
64	      if (focusableElements.length > 0 && props.autofocus !== false) {
65	        // If there's an element other than close, focus it.
66	        (focusableElements[1] || focusableElements[0]).focus();
67	      }
68	    });
69
70	    const handleKeyDown = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
71	      if (event.key === KEYS.TAB) {
72	        const focusableElements = queryFocusableElements(islandNode);
73	        const { activeElement } = document;
74	        const currentIndex = focusableElements.findIndex(
75	          (element) => element === activeElement,
76	        );
77
78	        if (currentIndex === 0 && event.shiftKey) {
79	          focusableElements[focusableElements.length - 1].focus();
80	          event.preventDefault();
81	        } else if (
82	          currentIndex === focusableElements.length - 1 &&
83	          !event.shiftKey
84	        ) {
85	          focusableElements[0].focus();
86	          event.preventDefault();
87	        }
88	      }
89	    };
90
91	    islandNode.addEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown);
92
93	    return () => islandNode.removeEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown);
94	  }, [islandNode, props.autofocus]);
95
96	  const setAppState = useExcalidrawSetAppState();
97	  const setIsLibraryMenuOpen = useSetAtom(isLibraryMenuOpenAtom);
98
99	  const onClose = () => {
100	    setAppState({ openMenu: null });
101	    setIsLibraryMenuOpen(false);
102	    (lastActiveElement as HTMLElement).focus();
103	    props.onCloseRequest();
104	  };
105
106	  return (
107	    <Modal
108	      className={clsx("Dialog", props.className, {
109	        "Dialog--fullscreen": isFullscreen,
110	      })}
111	      labelledBy="dialog-title"
112	      maxWidth={getDialogSize(props.size)}
113	      onCloseRequest={onClose}
114	      closeOnClickOutside={props.closeOnClickOutside}
115	    >
116	      <Island ref={setIslandNode}>
117	        {props.title && (
118	          <h2 id={`${id}-dialog-title`} className="Dialog__title">
119	            <span className="Dialog__titleContent">{props.title}</span>
120	          </h2>
121	        )}

131	          </button>
```

```typescript
import { DEFAULT_GRID_SIZE, arrayToMap } from "@excalidraw/common";

import { getNonDeletedElements } from "@excalidraw/element";

import {
  getSelectedElements,
  getSelectionStateForElements,
} from "@excalidraw/element";

import { syncMovedIndices } from "@excalidraw/element";

import { duplicateElements } from "@excalidraw/element";

import { CaptureUpdateAction } from "@excalidraw/element";

import { degreesToRadians, normalizeRadians } from "@excalidraw/math";

import type { Degrees, Radians } from "@excalidraw/math";

import { DuplicateIcon } from "../components/icons";

import { register } from "./register";

export const actionDuplicateRotated = register({
  name: "duplicateRotated",
  label: "labels.duplicateRotated",
  icon: DuplicateIcon,
  trackEvent: { category: "element" },
  perform: (elements, appState, formData, app) => {
    const rotationDegrees = typeof formData === "number" ? formData : undefined;

    // no angle provided yet -> ask the user for one first
    if (rotationDegrees === undefined) {
      return {
        elements,
        appState: {
          ...appState,
          openDialog: { name: "duplicateRotated" },
        },
        captureUpdate: CaptureUpdateAction.IMMEDIATELY,
      };
    }

    const rotationRadians = degreesToRadians(rotationDegrees as Degrees);

    let { duplicatedElements, elementsWithDuplicates } = duplicateElements({
      type: "in-place",
      elements,
      idsOfElementsToDuplicate: arrayToMap(
        getSelectedElements(elements, appState, {
          includeBoundTextElement: true,
          includeElementsInFrames: true,
        }),
      ),
      appState,
      randomizeSeed: true,
      overrides: ({ origElement, origIdToDuplicateId }) => {
        const duplicateFrameId =
          origElement.frameId && origIdToDuplicateId.get(origElement.frameId);
        return {
          x: origElement.x + DEFAULT_GRID_SIZE / 2,
          y: origElement.y + DEFAULT_GRID_SIZE / 2,
          angle: normalizeRadians(
            (origElement.angle + rotationRadians) as Radians,
          ),
          frameId: duplicateFrameId ?? origElement.frameId,
        };
      },
    });

    if (app.props.onDuplicate && elementsWithDuplicates) {
      const mappedElements = app.props.onDuplicate(
        elementsWithDuplicates,
        elements,
      );
      if (mappedElements) {
        elementsWithDuplicates = mappedElements;
      }
    }

    return {
      elements: syncMovedIndices(
        elementsWithDuplicates,
        arrayToMap(duplicatedElements),
      ),
      appState: {
        ...appState,
        openDialog: null,
        ...getSelectionStateForElements(
          duplicatedElements,
          getNonDeletedElements(elementsWithDuplicates),
          appState,
        ),
      },
      captureUpdate: CaptureUpdateAction.IMMEDIATELY,
    };
  },
});
```

```typescript
import { useState } from "react";

import { KEYS } from "@excalidraw/common";

import { actionDuplicateRotated } from "../actions/actionDuplicateRotated";
import { t } from "../i18n";

import { Dialog } from "./Dialog";
import DialogActionButton from "./DialogActionButton";

import "./ElementLinkDialog.scss";

import type { ActionManager } from "../actions/manager";

const DuplicateRotatedDialog = ({
  actionManager,
  onClose,
}: {
  actionManager: ActionManager;
  onClose: () => void;
}) => {
  const [angle, setAngle] = useState("90");

  const handleConfirm = () => {
    const angleDegrees = Number(angle);
    if (!Number.isFinite(angleDegrees)) {
      return;
    }
    actionManager.executeAction(actionDuplicateRotated, "ui", angleDegrees);
  };

  return (
    <Dialog onCloseRequest={onClose} title={t("duplicateRotatedDialog.title")}>
      <div className="ElementLinkDialog">
        <div className="ElementLinkDialog__header">
          <p>{t("duplicateRotatedDialog.desc")}</p>
        </div>

        <div className="ElementLinkDialog__input">
          <input
            type="number"
            value={angle}
            autoFocus
            className="ExcTextField__input"
            style={{ width: "100%" }}
            onChange={(event) => setAngle(event.target.value)}
            onKeyDown={(event) => {
              if (event.key === KEYS.ENTER) {
                handleConfirm();
              }
            }}
          />
        </div>

        <div className="ElementLinkDialog__actions">
          <DialogActionButton
            label={t("buttons.cancel")}
            onClick={onClose}
            style={{ marginRight: 10 }}
          />
          <DialogActionButton
            label={t("buttons.confirm")}
            onClick={handleConfirm}
            actionType="primary"
          />
        </div>
      </div>
    </Dialog>
  );
};

export default DuplicateRotatedDialog;
```

_**Agent (claude-sonnet-5 2026-09-17 21:08:34Z)**_

Typecheck passes and the context-menu tests are green. Here's what changed to add "Duplicate rotated..." to the element context menu with a configurable angle:

**New files:**

- `packages/excalidraw/actions/actionDuplicateRotated.tsx` — action named `duplicateRotated`. First click (no angle yet) opens a dialog by setting `appState.openDialog = { name: "duplicateRotated" }`. When called again with a numeric `formData` (the angle in degrees), it duplicates the selected elements via `duplicateElements` and sets each duplicate's `angle` to `origElement.angle + degreesToRadians(angle)` (normalized). Rotation is around each element's own center, so no x/y math is needed beyond the usual small duplicate offset.
- `packages/excalidraw/components/DuplicateRotatedDialog.tsx` — small dialog with a number input (defaults to 90°) and Confirm/Cancel; Confirm calls `actionManager.executeAction(actionDuplicateRotated, "ui", angleDegrees)`.

**Edited files:**

- `packages/excalidraw/actions/types.ts` — added `"duplicateRotated"` to `ActionName`.
- `packages/excalidraw/actions/index.ts` — exported the new action.
- `packages/excalidraw/types.ts` — added `{ name: "duplicateRotated" }` to `AppState["openDialog"]`.
- `packages/excalidraw/components/App.tsx` — imported the action and added it to the element context menu right after `actionDuplicateSelection`.
- `packages/excalidraw/components/LayerUI.tsx` — renders `DuplicateRotatedDialog` when `openDialog.name === "duplicateRotated"`.
- `packages/excalidraw/locales/en.json` — added `labels.duplicateRotated` and `duplicateRotatedDialog.{title,desc}`.
- `packages/excalidraw/tests/contextmenu.test.tsx` — added `"duplicateRotated"` to the three hardcoded expected-menu-item lists, then updated snapshots.

Right-clicking an element now shows "Duplicate rotated...", which opens a small dialog to enter the angle before duplicating.

```text
287	export const getCloneByOrigId = <T extends boolean = false>(
288	  origId: ExcalidrawElement["id"],
289	  returnNullIfNotExists: T = false as T,
290	): T extends true ? ExcalidrawElement | null : ExcalidrawElement => {
291	  const clonedElement = window.h.elements?.find(
292	    (el) => (el as any)[ORIG_ID] === origId,
293	  );
294	  if (clonedElement) {
295	    return clonedElement;
296	  }
297	  if (returnNullIfNotExists !== true) {
298	    throw new Error(`cloned element not found for origId: ${origId}`);
299	  }
300	  return null as T extends true ? ExcalidrawElement | null : ExcalidrawElement;
301	};
```

```typescript
import { ORIG_ID } from "@excalidraw/common";

import { degreesToRadians, normalizeRadians } from "@excalidraw/math";

import type { Degrees, Radians } from "@excalidraw/math";

import { Excalidraw } from "../index";
import { API } from "../tests/helpers/api";
import {
  act,
  assertElements,
  getCloneByOrigId,
  render,
} from "../tests/test-utils";

import { actionDuplicateRotated } from "./actionDuplicateRotated";

const { h } = window;

describe("actionDuplicateRotated", () => {
  beforeEach(async () => {
    await render(<Excalidraw />);
  });

  describe("asking for the rotation angle", () => {
    it("opens the duplicate-rotated dialog instead of duplicating when no angle was given yet", () => {
      const rectangle = API.createElement({ type: "rectangle" });

      API.setElements([rectangle]);
      API.setSelectedElements([rectangle]);

      act(() => {
        h.app.actionManager.executeAction(actionDuplicateRotated);
      });

      expect(h.elements.length).toBe(1);
      expect(h.state.openDialog?.name).toBe("duplicateRotated");
    });
  });

  describe("duplicating with a rotation angle", () => {
    it("duplicates the selected element and rotates the duplicate by the given angle", () => {
      const rectangle = API.createElement({ type: "rectangle", angle: 0 });

      API.setElements([rectangle]);
      API.setSelectedElements([rectangle]);

      act(() => {
        h.app.actionManager.executeAction(actionDuplicateRotated, "ui", 90);
      });

      assertElements(h.elements, [
        { id: rectangle.id, angle: 0 },
        {
          [ORIG_ID]: rectangle.id,
          angle: normalizeRadians(degreesToRadians(90 as Degrees)),
          selected: true,
        },
      ]);
      expect(h.state.openDialog).toBe(null);
    });

    it("adds the rotation on top of the original element's angle, rather than replacing it", () => {
      const originalAngle = degreesToRadians(30 as Degrees);
      const rectangle = API.createElement({
        type: "rectangle",
        angle: originalAngle,
      });

      API.setElements([rectangle]);
      API.setSelectedElements([rectangle]);

      act(() => {
        h.app.actionManager.executeAction(actionDuplicateRotated, "ui", 90);
      });

      assertElements(h.elements, [
        { id: rectangle.id, angle: originalAngle },
        {
          [ORIG_ID]: rectangle.id,
          angle: normalizeRadians(
            (originalAngle + degreesToRadians(90 as Degrees)) as Radians,
          ),
          selected: true,
        },
      ]);
    });

    it("normalizes the resulting angle so it wraps around 360 degrees", () => {
      const originalAngle = degreesToRadians(350 as Degrees);
      const rectangle = API.createElement({
        type: "rectangle",
        angle: originalAngle,
      });

      API.setElements([rectangle]);
      API.setSelectedElements([rectangle]);

      act(() => {
        h.app.actionManager.executeAction(actionDuplicateRotated, "ui", 30);
      });

      const duplicate = getCloneByOrigId(rectangle.id);
      expect(duplicate.angle).toBeCloseTo(degreesToRadians(20 as Degrees));
    });

    it("rotates each selected element independently, around its own center", () => {
      const rect1 = API.createElement({ type: "rectangle", angle: 0 });
      const rect2 = API.createElement({
        type: "ellipse",
        angle: degreesToRadians(45 as Degrees),
      });

      API.setElements([rect1, rect2]);
      API.setSelectedElements([rect1, rect2]);

      act(() => {
        h.app.actionManager.executeAction(actionDuplicateRotated, "ui", 90);
      });

      assertElements(h.elements, [
        { id: rect1.id, angle: 0 },
        { id: rect2.id, angle: degreesToRadians(45 as Degrees) },
        {
          [ORIG_ID]: rect1.id,
          angle: normalizeRadians(degreesToRadians(90 as Degrees)),
          selected: true,
        },
        {
          [ORIG_ID]: rect2.id,
          angle: normalizeRadians(degreesToRadians(135 as Degrees)),
          selected: true,
        },
      ]);
    });

    it("keeps frame membership when duplicating an element inside a frame", () => {
      const frame = API.createElement({ type: "frame" });
      const rectangle = API.createElement({
        type: "rectangle",
        frameId: frame.id,
      });

      API.setElements([frame, rectangle]);
      API.setSelectedElements([rectangle]);

      act(() => {
        h.app.actionManager.executeAction(actionDuplicateRotated, "ui", 90);
      });

      assertElements(h.elements, [
        { id: frame.id },
        { id: rectangle.id, frameId: frame.id, angle: 0 },
        {
          [ORIG_ID]: rectangle.id,
          frameId: frame.id,
          angle: normalizeRadians(degreesToRadians(90 as Degrees)),
          selected: true,
        },
      ]);
    });
  });
});
```

_**Agent (claude-sonnet-5 2026-09-17 23:29:57Z)**_

The 6 test failures aren't a problem with the tests — `actionDuplicateRotated.tsx` has changed on disk since I last wrote it, and the new version is broken relative to what we built:

1. **The dialog-opening branch is gone** (commented out) — clicking the context menu item now duplicates immediately instead of asking for an angle.
2. **The rotation formula changed** from `origElement.angle + rotationRadians` to `normalizeRadians(2 * origElement.angle)` — it no longer uses the angle you type in at all; it just doubles the original element's existing angle.
3. **A `keyTest: Ctrl+D` was added**, which collides with `actionDuplicateSelection`'s existing `Ctrl+D` shortcut (the action manager warns and no-ops when two actions match the same shortcut).
4. **A `PanelComponent` was added** that duplicates unconditionally on click with no rotation input — duplicating `actionDuplicateSelection`'s toolbar button behavior instead of opening the angle dialog.
5. There's leftover commented-out dead code and inconsistent indentation in the `perform`/`PanelComponent` block.

My test file is correctly written against the _intended_ behavior (open dialog first, then rotate by `angle + input` on confirm) — that's why all 6 fail against the current file on disk.

Did you (or something else) intentionally rewrite this file, or should I restore it to the working version from earlier in this conversation? I don't want to overwrite changes you meant to make, but as-is the feature is broken and conflicts with the existing duplicate shortcut.

_**Agent (claude-sonnet-5 2026-09-17 23:33:24Z)**_

<tool-use data-tool-type="write" data-tool-name="Write"><details>

<summary>Tool use: **Write**</summary>

```typescript
import { ORIG_ID } from "@excalidraw/common";

import { degreesToRadians, normalizeRadians } from "@excalidraw/math";

import type { Degrees, Radians } from "@excalidraw/math";

import { Excalidraw } from "../index";
import { API } from "../tests/helpers/api";
import {
  act,
  assertElements,
  getCloneByOrigId,
  render,
} from "../tests/test-utils";

import { actionDuplicateRotated } from "./actionDuplicateRotated";

const { h } = window;

const doubled = (angleDegrees: number) =>
  normalizeRadians((2 * degreesToRadians(angleDegrees as Degrees)) as Radians);

describe("actionDuplicateRotated", () => {
  beforeEach(async () => {
    await render(<Excalidraw />);
  });

  it("duplicates the selected element immediately, without requiring extra input", () => {
    const rectangle = API.createElement({ type: "rectangle" });

    API.setElements([rectangle]);
    API.setSelectedElements([rectangle]);

    act(() => {
      h.app.actionManager.executeAction(actionDuplicateRotated);
    });

    expect(h.elements.length).toBe(2);
    expect(h.state.openDialog).toBe(null);
  });

  it("sets the duplicate's angle to double the original element's angle", () => {
    const originalAngle = degreesToRadians(30 as Degrees);
    const rectangle = API.createElement({
      type: "rectangle",
      angle: originalAngle,
    });

    API.setElements([rectangle]);
    API.setSelectedElements([rectangle]);

    act(() => {
      h.app.actionManager.executeAction(actionDuplicateRotated);
    });

    assertElements(h.elements, [
      { id: rectangle.id, angle: originalAngle },
      {
        [ORIG_ID]: rectangle.id,
        angle: doubled(30),
        selected: true,
      },
    ]);
  });

  it("leaves the duplicate unrotated when the original has a zero angle", () => {
    const rectangle = API.createElement({ type: "rectangle", angle: 0 });

    API.setElements([rectangle]);
    API.setSelectedElements([rectangle]);

    act(() => {
      h.app.actionManager.executeAction(actionDuplicateRotated);
    });

    const duplicate = getCloneByOrigId(rectangle.id);
    expect(duplicate.angle).toBe(0);
  });

  it("normalizes the doubled angle so it wraps around 360 degrees", () => {
    const originalAngle = degreesToRadians(200 as Degrees);
    const rectangle = API.createElement({
      type: "rectangle",
      angle: originalAngle,
    });

    API.setElements([rectangle]);
    API.setSelectedElements([rectangle]);

    act(() => {
      h.app.actionManager.executeAction(actionDuplicateRotated);
    });

    const duplicate = getCloneByOrigId(rectangle.id);
    expect(duplicate.angle).toBeCloseTo(doubled(200));
    expect(duplicate.angle).toBeCloseTo(degreesToRadians(40 as Degrees));
  });

  it("doubles each selected element's angle independently", () => {
    const rect1 = API.createElement({
      type: "rectangle",
      angle: degreesToRadians(10 as Degrees),
    });
    const rect2 = API.createElement({
      type: "ellipse",
      angle: degreesToRadians(45 as Degrees),
    });

    API.setElements([rect1, rect2]);
    API.setSelectedElements([rect1, rect2]);

    act(() => {
      h.app.actionManager.executeAction(actionDuplicateRotated);
    });

    assertElements(h.elements, [
      { id: rect1.id, angle: degreesToRadians(10 as Degrees) },
      { id: rect2.id, angle: degreesToRadians(45 as Degrees) },
      {
        [ORIG_ID]: rect1.id,
        angle: doubled(10),
        selected: true,
      },
      {
        [ORIG_ID]: rect2.id,
        angle: doubled(45),
        selected: true,
      },
    ]);
  });

  it("keeps frame membership when duplicating a rotated element inside a frame", () => {
    const frame = API.createElement({ type: "frame" });
    const rectangle = API.createElement({
      type: "rectangle",
      frameId: frame.id,
      angle: degreesToRadians(15 as Degrees),
    });

    API.setElements([frame, rectangle]);
    API.setSelectedElements([rectangle]);

    act(() => {
      h.app.actionManager.executeAction(actionDuplicateRotated);
    });

    assertElements(h.elements, [
      { id: frame.id },
      {
        id: rectangle.id,
        frameId: frame.id,
        angle: degreesToRadians(15 as Degrees),
      },
      {
        [ORIG_ID]: rectangle.id,
        frameId: frame.id,
        angle: doubled(15),
        selected: true,
      },
    ]);
  });
});
```

Lint is clean now. Test file is done and passing (6/6), matching your "double the original angle" behavior:

- duplicates immediately (no dialog)

- zero-angle originals stay unrotated (2×0=0)
- angle wraps correctly past 360°
- multiple selected elements are doubled independently
- frame membership is preserved

One thing worth flagging since I noticed it while reading the file: `actionDuplicateRotated` now has `keyTest: (event) => event[KEYS.CTRL_OR_CMD] && event.key === KEYS.D`, which is the exact same shortcut `actionDuplicateSelection` already uses. `ActionManager.handleKeyDown` requires exactly one action to match a shortcut — with two actions bound to Ctrl/Cmd+D, it logs a warning and does nothing, so **your normal Ctrl+D duplicate shortcut is currently broken**. Want me to remove that `keyTest` from `actionDuplicateRotated` (it's only reachable via the context menu right now anyway), or handle it some other way?
